{{Top|leg}}{{Youmay|the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]|the [[canon]] [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander]] or the canon [[Mirialan]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[scientist]] [[Reeva Demesne]]|linebreak=1}}{{Character|type=|image=|name=Reva|homeworld=[[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]|birth=|death=|species=[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]|gender=[[Gender/Legends|Female]]|pronouns=new|height=|mass=|hair=|feathers=|eyes=|skin=|cyber=|families=new|parents=new|partners=new|siblings=new|children=new|affiliation=|masters=|apprentices=}}'''Reva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and lived on the world for all her life. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Thaereian military]] was driven out of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and Cularin became a full voting member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the aftermath of the transfer of power, Reva attended a rally in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] that had been organized by the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Nia Reston]] and [[San Herrera]], and she voiced her opinion on the changeover, stating that she believed Cularin did not need [[Thaere Privo|Thaere]] and that it did not need the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]. A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] subsequently spoke in support of Reva's claim.
